structurally_ineligible_only_if: documented materially distinct exact-source routes have been exhausted
each route was evaluated under the same frozen public/auditable source semantics
failure is structural observability/source availability rather than temporary collector defect
no admissible exact-source contract can currently satisfy frozen continuity/schema/OHLCV QA
not_sufficient_for_exclusion: ordinary missing bucket without source exhaustion
private-only source when a public exact source still exists
NAV/oracle/transfer data that is semantically incompatible with spot execution OHLCV
rule.completeness_definition: For the next replacement Dataset Epoch D0 only, completeness is evaluated against the ex-ante eligible universe after applying this rule. Structurally ineligible members remain preserved in an immutable exclusion ledger and are not counted as observed, repaired, or credited.
rule.eligible_denominator_freeze: Freeze the eligible-universe denominator at the first valid post-rule D0 snapshot. No silent denominator changes are allowed within the epoch.
rule.reentry_rule: An excluded member may re-enter only through a separately preregistered future eligibility event after a materially new exact public/auditable source is demonstrated. Re-entry cannot rewrite prior epoch evidence.
